{"script":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -o pipefail
base="temp_workspace/npm_check"
mkdir -p "$base/user_configs"
# 2. env snapshot
env > "$base/env_snapshot.txt"
# Also extract specific relevant vars for convenience
{
  echo "--- PATH ---"
  printf "%s\n" "$PATH"
  echo "--- LD_LIBRARY_PATH ---"
  printf "%s\n" "$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
  echo "--- MANPATH ---"
  printf "%s\n" "$MANPATH"
  echo "--- PYTHONPATH ---"
  printf "%s\n" "$PYTHONPATH"
  echo "--- PKG_CONFIG_PATH ---"
  printf "%s\n" "$PKG_CONFIG_PATH"
  echo "--- NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX ---"
  printf "%s\n" "$NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX"
} >> "$base/env_snapshot.txt"

# 3. likely dirs for global executables
cat > "$base/dirs_list.txt" <<'DIRS'
/usr/local/bin
/usr/bin
/bin
/usr/local/sbin
/usr/sbin
/snap/bin
/var/lib/snapd/snap/bin
/opt/bin
/opt/node/bin
$HOME/.local/bin
$HOME/.npm-global/bin
$HOME/.nvm/versions/*/bin
$HOME/.npm/bin
/home/*/.local/bin
DIRS
# expand globs and env vars, keep unique
python3 - <<PY > "$base/dirs_list_expanded.txt"
import os,glob
p=open('"$base"/dirs_list.txt').read().splitlines()
out=[]
for line in p:
    line=os.path.expandvars(line)
    if '*' in line:
        out+=glob.glob(line)
    else:
        out.append(line)
# unique preserving order
seen=set();res=[]
for d in out:
    if d not in seen:
        seen.add(d);res.append(d)
print('\n'.join(res))
PY
# final dirs_list: include expanded plus original literals
cat "$base/dirs_list_expanded.txt" "$base/dirs_list.txt" | awk '!seen[$0]++' > "$base/dirs_list.txt"
rm -f "$base/dirs_list_expanded.txt"

# 4. search for candidate executables
: > "$base/candidates.txt"
while IFS= read -r d; do
  # ignore empty
  [ -z "$d" ] && continue
  # expand ~ if any
  d=${d/#~/$HOME}
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    for f in "$d"/*; do
      [ -e "$f" ] || continue
      bn=$(basename "${f}")
      case "$bn" in
        npm|npm.*|npm-cli.*|npx|npx.*|pnpm|pnpm.*|yarn|yarn.*|yarnpkg|yarnpkg.*|node|node.*|corepack|corepack.*)
          printf "%s\n" "$f" >> "$base/candidates.txt"
          ;;
      esac
    done
  fi
done < "$base/dirs_list.txt"
# make unique
[ -f "$base/candidates.txt" ] && awk '!seen[$0]++' "$base/candidates.txt" > "$base/candidates.txt.tmp" && mv "$base/candidates.txt.tmp" "$base/candidates.txt"

# 5. system package metadata referencing package manager
# gather dpkg entries (if available)
{ dpkg -l 2>/dev/null || true; } | egrep -i 'npm|nodejs|yarn|pnpm|corepack' >/dev/null 2>&1 && dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | egrep -i 'npm|nodejs|yarn|pnpm|corepack' > "$base/pm_packages.txt" || true
# also try apt list --installed
apt list --installed 2>/dev/null | egrep -i 'npm|nodejs|yarn|pnpm|corepack' >> "$base/pm_packages.txt" 2>/dev/null || true

# 6. Collect user-level package manager config files
configs=("$HOME/.npmrc" "$HOME/.npmrc-private" "$HOME/.npm/_npx" "$HOME/.npm" "$HOME/.config/yarn" "$HOME/.yarnrc" "$HOME/.yarnrc.yml" "$HOME/.pnpmfile.cjs" "$HOME/.pnpmrc" "$HOME/.nvmrc" "$HOME/.node_repl_history")
for c in "${configs[@]}"; do
  if [ -e "$c" ]; then
    # preserve directory structure under user_configs
    rel=$(realpath --relative-to="$HOME" "$c" 2>/dev/null || basename "$c")
    target="$base/user_configs/$rel"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
    cp -a "$c" "$target" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
done
# also copy any npm config under ~/.config
if [ -d "$HOME/.config" ]; then
  for d in "$HOME/.config/npm" "$HOME/.config/configstore" "$HOME/.config/yarn"; do
    if [ -e "$d" ]; then
      dest="$base/user_configs/$(realpath --relative-to="$HOME" "$d")"
      mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
      cp -a "$d" "$dest" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  done
fi

# 7. Verify permissions and compute checksums
: > "$base/checksums.txt"
if [ -f "$base/candidates.txt" ]; then
  tmp="$base/candidates.updated.txt"
  : > "$tmp"
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -z "$p" ] && continue
    r="no"; x="no"
    [ -r "$p" ] && r="yes"
    [ -x "$p" ] && x="yes"
    echo "$p r=$r x=$x" >> "$tmp"
    if [ -r "$p" ]; then
      sha256sum "$p" >> "$base/checksums.txt" 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256 "$p" >> "$base/checksums.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
    else
      echo "UNREADABLE  $p" >> "$base/checksums.txt"
    fi
  done < "$base/candidates.txt"
  mv "$tmp" "$base/candidates.txt"
fi

# 8. Consolidate into evidence_summary.txt
{
  echo "==== env_snapshot.txt ===="
  cat "$base/env_snapshot.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "\n==== dirs_list.txt ===="
  cat "$base/dirs_list.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "\n==== candidates.txt ===="
  cat "$base/candidates.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "\n==== pm_packages.txt ===="
  cat "$base/pm_packages.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "\n==== user_configs listing ===="
  if [ -d "$base/user_configs" ]; then find "$base/user_configs" -type f -maxdepth 5 -print; fi
  echo "\n==== checksums.txt ===="
  cat "$base/checksums.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
} > "$base/evidence_summary.txt"

# Final determination whether npm is installed (check command -v and candidates/dpkg)
ans="no"
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ans="yes"
else
  # also check if any candidate basename is npm
  if [ -f "$base/candidates.txt" ] && grep -E '/npm(\b|\.|$)' "$base/candidates.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ans="yes"
  elif [ -s "$base/pm_packages.txt" ]; then
    ans="yes"
  fi
fi
# print only the answer as last line
printf "%s\n" "$ans"
"}
